author: (Bory de Saint-Vincent) Papenfuss, 1968

note.en: A fine, soft red tuft that looks much like other Spyridia and is known here from one specimen on the north side of Punta Cahuita.
note.es: Un mechón rojo fino y suave, muy parecido a otras Spyridia, que se conoce aquí por un ejemplar del lado norte de Punta Cahuita.

evidence: GBIF herbarium specimen: Punta Cahuita (1999, Freshwater, Wilson and Hommersand)

sources.t: GBIF herbarium specimen records inside the region box (Gandoca to Limón)
